sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF TN AND KY
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... IL/IND UPR LOW EXPECTED TO DEVOLVE INTO AN OPEN TROUGH AS IT CONTINUES E INTO OH BY EVE AND THE MID ATLANTIC STATES EARLY TUE. ASSOCIATED BELT OF ENHANCED MID-LVL FLOW WILL PERSIST OVER TN TODAY...AND OVERSPREAD THE SRN APPALACHIANS...THE CAROLINAS...AND VA LATER BY MID-LATE AFTN. AHEAD OF THE LOW...LOW-LVL MOISTURE WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD NEWD INTO THE THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES... WITH THE 70 DEG F ISODROSOTHERM REACHING SE PA/SRN NJ BY EVE. SCTD TSTMS...SOME POSSIBLY SVR...WILL OCCUR IN THE MOISTENING ENVIRONMENT FROM PARTS OF GA NEWD INTO PA/NJ. OTHER STRONG TO SVR STORMS MAY OCCUR BENEATH THE UPR TROUGH OVER PARTS OF KY AND TN. FARTHER W...FLAT UPR RIDGE WILL BUILD E/NE ACROSS THE CNTRL PLNS...WITH ISOLD HIGH-BASED STORMS POSSIBLE FROM ERN CO INTO WRN KS. ON THE NW FLANK OF THE RIDGE...A BELT OF STRONG ZONAL FLOW OVER THE NRN GRT BASIN/NRN RCKYS IN CONJUNCTION WITH A PASSING JET STREAK MAY SUPPORT A FEW STRONG TO SVR AFTN/EVE STORMS OVER PARTS OF ID...WY...AND MT.

sections.title: NE GA TO PA/NJ THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: HEIGHT FALLS ASSOCIATED WITH PROGRESSIVE UPR TROUGH AND DOWNSTREAM LOW-LVL CONFLUENCE SHOULD SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF NUMEROUS BANDS AND SMALL CLUSTERS OF TSTMS BY EARLY AFTN IN MOISTENING/WEAKLY-CAPPED ENVIRONMENT FROM PARTS OF GA/SC NEWD INTO THE CHESAPEAKE BAY REGION. AREA HODOGRAPHS...ALREADY SEASONABLY LENGTHY...MAY FURTHER LENGTHEN AS BELT OF 40-50 KT SWLY MID-LVL FLOW OVERSPREADS REGION...SUGGESTING LIKELIHOOD FOR SUPERCELLS/LEWPS/SMALL BOWS WITH NARROW SWATHS OF DMGG WINDS. WHILE LOW-LVL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN LIMITED EXCEPT NEAR DIFFUSE WARM FRONT IN SRN PA/ERN MD/DE/NJ...IT WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR TORNADOES GIVEN MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER. THE SVR THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH WITH NOCTURNAL COOLING THIS EVE/EARLY TNGT.

sections.title: MIDDLE/ERN TN AND SRN KY THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: SATELLITE SUGGESTS THAT STRONG SFC HEATING WILL OCCUR OVER PARTS OF TN AND KY TODAY...IN BASE OF MID-LVL TROUGH WHERE 40+ KT WLY FLOW AND COLD AIR ALOFT WILL EXIST ATOP LOW-LVL THETA-E AXIS. SETUP APPEARS FAVORABLE FOR A CLUSTER OF STORMS TO EVOLVE INTO ONE OR TWO BANDS THAT COULD INCLUDE EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS/BOWING SEGMENTS WITH LARGE HAIL AND...ESPECIALLY LATER THIS AFTN...DMGG WIND.

sections.title: NRN RCKYS LATE THIS AFTN INTO TNGT
sections.text: SFC HEATING...COOL MID-LVL TEMPS...AND LARGE-SCALE ASCENT IN ENTRANCE REGION OF JET STREAK MOVING FROM NRN MT INTO NRN ND SHOULD SUPPORT SCTD TSTMS MAINLY OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF ERN ID...NW WY...AND SW MT. WHILE INSTABILITY WILL BE LIMITED...50+ KT WSWLY DEEP SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS. A FEW STORMS MAY CONTAIN LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND POSSIBLY A SPOT OR TWO OF HAIL. ..CNTRL HIGH PLNS THIS AFTN/EVE... VERY STRONG SFC HEATING WILL OCCUR OVER ERN CO...SE WY...WRN NEB...AND WRN KS ON SRN EDGE OF THE WLYS. WHILE MOISTURE WILL REMAIN LIMITED...RELATIVELY COOL MID-LVL TEMPS WILL YIELD SIZABLE BUOYANCY. CONVERGENCE ALONG LEE TROUGH SHOULD FOSTER WDLY SCTD HIGH-BASED DIURNAL STORMS. THESE SHOULD MOVE E OR ESE INTO THE EVE...AND MAY MERGE INTO A SMALL CLUSTER OR TWO WITH ISOLD SVR WIND GUSTS AND SMALL HAIL. ANOTHER AREA OF STORMS MAY FORM ALONG SEPARATE SEGMENT OF LEE TROUGH OVER NE NM...SE CO...SW KS...AND THE OK/TX PANHANDLE REGION...WHERE ISOLD STRONG WIND GUSTS ALSO MAY OCCUR. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 06/10/2013

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF TN AND KY
sections.text: PREVIOUS FORECAST REASONING REMAINS ON TRACK AND ONLY CHANGES MADE WITH THE 20Z OUTLOOK WERE TO INCLUDE A SMALL 5 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITY ACROSS PORTIONS OF TN...AND TO EXTEND 10 PERCENT THUNDER LINE SLIGHTLY EWD ACROSS WRN KS. ..BUNTING.. 06/10/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT MON JUN 10 2013/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY THROUGH THE EARLY/MIDDLE PART OF THE AFTERNOON FROM FAR NORTHEAST GA INTO WESTERN/PIEDMONT OF SC AND THE PIEDMONT OF NC. THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR DAMAGING WINDS ASIDE FROM SOME TORNADO RISK. A WATCH ISSUANCE IS LIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SHOWERS/INCIPIENT TSTMS HAVE SHOWN SOME SIGNS OF INCREASE WITHIN A BROAD WARM SECTOR EAST OF THE APPALACHIANS SPINE INCLUDING A CORRIDOR FROM NORTH GA INTO UPSTATE SC/WEST-CENTRAL NC. FORCING FOR ASCENT/VERTICAL SHEAR WILL TEND TO GENERALLY INCREASE OVER THE REGION THE REMINDER OF THE AFTERNOON UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF AN EASTWARD-ADVANCING UPPER LOW OVER THE OH VALLEY AND KY/TN. THE DEGREE OF DESTABILIZATION WILL BE TEMPERED BY EXISTING CLOUD COVER/WIDELY SCATTERED CORRIDORS OF EARLY DAY PRECIPITATION. HOWEVER...BOUNDARY LAYER CINH IS VERY MINIMAL /ADJUSTED REGIONAL 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS/ AND MODEST CLOUD BREAKS/POCKETS OF LOCALLY STRONGER HEATING WILL ALLOW FOR MLCAPES TO REACH OR EXCEED 500 J/KG WITHIN A VERY MOIST AIRMASS /LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/. AS UPDRAFTS/STORMS MATURE COINCIDENT WITH MORE DESTABILIZATION...WELL-ORGANIZED/MAINLY LINEAR STRUCTURES INCLUDING POSSIBLE SMALL BOWS/LEWPS WILL LIKELY EVOLVE...ALTHOUGH SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS/SUPERCELLS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MOST PROBABLE CONCERN...ALTHOUGH SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL SHEAR MAY EXIST WITHIN A MOIST ENVIRONMENT FOR A TORNADO RISK AS WELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY THROUGH THE EARLY-MIDDLE PART OF THE AFTERNOON WITHIN A CORRIDOR ACROSS NORTHERN NC INTO MUCH OF VA AND EVENTUALLY ADJACENT PARTS OF MD/DE AND FAR SOUTHERN PA/NJ. WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO RISK BEING CONCERNS...PORTIONS OF THE REGION ARE LIKELY TO NEED A WATCH THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDELY SCATTERED SHOWERS/SOME TSTMS ARE NOTED WITHIN A BROAD/CONFLUENT WARM SECTOR ESPECIALLY FROM THE NC PIEDMONT INTO SOUTHEAST VA...WITH OTHER DEVELOPMENT FARTHER WEST NEAR/WEST OF THE APPALACHIANS SPINE IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO THE DEEPER FRONT. CLOUD COVER HAS LIKELY BEEN HINDERING THE DEGREE OF DESTABILIZATION/UPDRAFT VIGOR THUS FAR. HOWEVER...SOME THINNING OF CLOUD COVER IS NOTED OUTSIDE ONGOING SHOWERS/TSTMS...AND A GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS IS PROBABLE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WITHIN A VERY MOIST AIRMASS /LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/...WITH AID OF THE UPSTREAM APPROACHING/EASTWARD-MOVING OPENING UPPER LOW. AS UPDRAFTS/STORMS MATURE...IN CONJUNCTION WITH A PROBABLE STRENGTHENING OF LOWER TROPOSPHERIC SOUTH-SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS THIS AFTERNOON...A COMBINATION OF SEMI-DISCRETE/SMALLER SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG WITH A PROBABLE EVOLUTION OF RELATIVELY FAST-MOVING LINEAR SEGMENTS WITH EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURES/LEWP DEVELOPMENT. DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL WILL EXIST ASIDE FROM AN ISOLATED TORNADO RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WITH INCREASING TSTM COVERAGE/INTENSITY ANTICIPATED ACROSS PORTIONS OF MIDDLE/EASTERN TN INTO EASTERN KY AND EVENTUALLY FAR WESTERN VA THIS AFTERNOON...DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. A WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED FOR PORTIONS OF THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS HAVE BEGUN TO INCREASE NEAR THE SOUTH-CENTRAL KY/TN BORDER VICINITY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON...ON THE IMMEDIATE PERIPHERY OF AN EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD MOVING UPPER LOW OVER THE LOWER OH VALLEY PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. RELATIVELY STRONG INSOLATION IS OCCURRING JUST AHEAD OF THIS DEVELOPMENT...WITH RELATIVELY CLOUD-FREE SKIES ACROSS EASTERN PORTIONS OF KY/TN AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES CONTINUE TO CLIMB THROUGH THE 70S F/LOWER 80S F. AS STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/MATURE...A BAND OF STRONG WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY LOW-MID TROPOSPHERIC FLOW ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF THE UPPER LOW...WITH 50+ KT BETWEEN 3-6 KM PER REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS...WILL CONTINUE TO OVERSPREAD THE REGION. THIS WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORM MODES INCLUDING INITIAL SUPERCELLS ALONG WITH THE EVOLUTION OF EAST-SOUTHEAST MOVING/ACCELERATING BANDS OF STORMS/LINE SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF PRIMARILY WIND DAMAGE/SEVERE HAIL...BUT A TORNADO MAY BE POSSIBLE AS WELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 292 CONTINUES UNTIL 02Z...WITH CONTINUED POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ESPECIALLY ACROSS PIEDMONT/INLAND COASTAL PORTIONS OF THE CAROLINAS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE EAST-NORTHEASTWARD MOVING BANDS/CLUSTERS OF TSTMS CONTINUE TO SPREAD ACROSS TORNADO WATCH 292 INCLUDING EAST-CENTRAL GA INTO THE PIEDMONT/INLAND COASTAL PORTIONS OF SC/NC. EVEN WITH A NUMBER OF SHOWERS/TSTMS AND ONLY BROKEN CLOUD COVER...SOME LOCATIONS HAVE LOCALLY REACHED THE LOWER/MIDDLE 80S F THIS AFTERNOON...WHICH MAY BE CONTRIBUTING TO AS MUCH AS 1000 J/KG OF MLCAPE PER LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS. WITH THE BRUNT OF FORCING FOR ASCENT APPEARING TO BE QUASI-FOCUSED ACROSS NC/ADJACENT SC...BOUTS OF WIND DAMAGE WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY ACROSS THE EAST-CENTRAL PORTIONS OF THE CAROLINAS THIS AFTERNOON GIVEN 40-50 KT MID-LEVEL SOUTHWESTERLIES. THE POTENTIAL ALSO EXISTS FOR TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF A TORNADO OR TWO GIVEN A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER /LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/ AND ADEQUATE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR. ..GUYER.. 06/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MICROBURSTS POTENTIALLY CAPABLE OF ISOLD SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY DEVELOP THIS AFTN/EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SUBJECTIVE SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE FROM ERN NM ARCING NEWD INTO SWRN KS. SURFACE TEMPS HAVE RECENTLY BREACHED 100 DEG F ACROSS MUCH OF THE DISCUSSION AREA WITH DEWPOINTS MIXING INTO THE 30S NEAR THE RATON MESA TO AROUND 50 OVER THE CNTRL OK PANHANDLE. RAP FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW MODERATE BUOYANCY /AOA 1000 J/KG SBCAPE/ WITH DEEPLY MIXED INVERTED-V PROFILES FEATURING NEARLY DRY ADIABATIC LAPSE RATES FROM THE SURFACE-H5. AS 15 KT WLY MEAN WIND SERVES TO AID IN AN EWD MOVEMENT OF STORMS FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN TO THE PLAINS...UPDRAFTS WILL MOVE INTO SLIGHTLY HIGHER PW /0.75 INCH/. AS A RESULT...ISOLD STORMS WITH AN ATTENDANT SEVERE MICROBURST THREAT MAY DEVELOP OVER NERN NM AND FAR SERN CO AND SPREAD EWD INTO ADJACENT AREAS OF TX/OK/KS DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLD SEVERE MICROBURST THREAT MAY DEVELOP NEAR THE WY/NEB BORDER AND SPREAD EWD INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW LARGE TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS /50-60 DEG F/ OVER SERN WY INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE AHEAD OF A DEVELOPING CLUSTER OF HIGH-BASED STORMS OVER SERN WY. KCYS SHOWS APPRECIABLE 4-8 KM LAYER FLOW /WLY AT 30 KT/ AND THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO 20-25 KT MEAN WLY WIND. STEEP LAPSE RATES AND SEEMINGLY ADEQUATE MID-LEVEL FLOW WOULD AT LEAST FAVOR THE NOTION THAT A CLUSTER OF STORMS CAPABLE OF STRONG-SEVERE MICROBURSTS WILL MOVE/DEVELOP EWD INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. THIS LATEST THINKING IS SUPPORTED BY THE 12Z SPC SSEO EXPERIMENTAL WIND GUIDANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 293 CONTINUES UNTIL 02Z. THIS INCLUDES POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE AND A TORNADO OR TWO FROM FAR NORTHERN NC INTO CENTRAL/EASTERN VA AND ADJACENT PORTIONS OF MD/DE INTO SOUTHERN PA/NJ...AND PERHAPS EVEN ADDITIONAL PARTS OF PA CURRENTLY OUTSIDE OF WW 293 /MONITORING TRENDS/.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CORRIDOR OF SHOWERS/EMBEDDED TSTMS...WITH A FEW EARLIER INSTANCES OF TRANSIENT SMALL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES...CONTINUE TO SHIFT EASTWARD/OFFSHORE ALONG COASTAL PORTIONS OF VA/MD INTO DE/NJ LATE THIS AFTERNOON. MEANWHILE...FARTHER WEST...ADDITIONAL TSTMS ARE LIKELY TO CONTINUE TO MOVE EAST-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL NC/MUCH OF CENTRAL VA THROUGH EARLY EVENING COINCIDENT WITH A SECONDARY ZONE OF CONFLUENCE/FORCING FOR ASCENT JUST AHEAD OF AN UPPER DRY SLOT AS PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. GIVEN THIS FORCING...WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVING REACHED THE LOWER 80S F ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL NC INTO CENTRAL PORTIONS OF VA/MD...SOME ADDITIONAL INTENSIFICATION IS POSSIBLE WITH THIS SECONDARY WAVE OF TSTMS. ESPECIALLY GIVEN THAT WINDS IN THE LOWEST FEW KM HAVE GRADUALLY STRENGTHENED OVER THE PAST FEW HOURS...THE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR BOTH SUSTAINED LINEAR SEGMENTS/SMALL BOWS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE...AS WELL AS TRANSIENT/SMALL SUPERCELLS WITH A TORNADO RISK. OF NOTE...COINCIDENT WITH A MODEST DEEPENING OF THE SURFACE LOW ACROSS THE UPPER OH VALLEY...A TRANSIENT SUPERCELL/SMALL BOW RISK MAY EXTEND NORTHWARD INTO ADDITIONAL PARTS OF PA LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING NEAR A WARM FRONT...ALTHOUGH DESTABILIZATION HAS REMAINED TEMPERED THUS FAR. ..GUYER.. 06/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO DEVELOP THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ALONG THE ID/MT BORDER VICINITY EASTWARD INTO ADDITIONAL PARTS OF SOUTH-CENTRAL MT AND NORTHWEST/NORTH-CENTRAL WY. LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE/PERHAPS SOME HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AIDED BY THE ENTRANCE REGION OF AN UPPER JET...A DEEPENING CU FIELD WITH INCIPIENT TSTM DEVELOPMENT HAS BEGUN TO OCCUR OVER THE MOUNTAINS ALONG THE ID/MT BORDER...EASTWARD INTO NORTHWEST WY/ADJACENT MT. AS ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT OCCURS...A RELATIVELY STRONG DEEP LAYER WIND FIELD WILL SUPPORT SOME ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES INCLUDING A FEW HIGH-BASED SUPERCELLS. STRONG MEAN LAYER SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS AND THE WELL-MIXED NATURE OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT STRONG DOWNDRAFT/POSSIBILITY OF LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE IN ADDITION TO THE POSSIBILITY OF SOME HAIL. WHILE THE THREAT MAY REMAIN RELATIVELY MARGINAL/ISOLATED OVERALL...SOME CONSIDERATION MAY NEED TO BE GIVEN TO AN OUTLOOK UPGRADE/POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MONITORING FOR A POSSIBLE DOWNSTREAM WW FOR ERN NC...E/S OF WW 292/293 WITH ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND/MARGINAL TORNADO THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: QLCS ALONG THE NRN SC/SRN NC COASTAL PLAIN HAS CROSSED INTO RECENTLY EXTENDED WW 292. THERE IS SOME CONCERN FOR A MARGINAL WIND DAMAGE THREAT TO DEVELOP FARTHER NE IN ERN NC. HOWEVER...DOWNSTREAM WIND SHEAR IS WEAKER PER MHX/LTX VWP DATA...MORE MARGINAL FOR EITHER A TORNADO/DAMAGING WIND THREAT. IN ADDITION...RECENT HRRR GUIDANCE SUGGEST CONVECTION WILL WEAKEN AS IT MOVES E/NEWD THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT APPEARS RATHER LOCALIZED AND SHOULD REMAIN SO NEAR-TERM AS PRIMARY BELT OF FORCED ASCENT SHIFTS DOWNSTREAM OF WW 294. DOWNSTREAM WW INTO NRN AL NOT ANTICIPATED ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE HIGHER MID-LEVEL REFLECTIVITY CORES ASSOCIATED WITH TN VALLEY CONVECTION HAVE REMAINED ACROSS CNTRL KY AND ARE ABOUT TO CROSS WW 294 INTO WW 295 IN ERN TN. THIS TREND SHOULD CONTINUE OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS AS WELL-DEFINED SHORTWAVE TROUGH IN WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHIFTS EWD. WITH A W/NWLY LOW/MID-LEVEL FLOW REGIME IN THE WAKE OF THE TROUGH AXIS PASSING...WARMING/SUBSIDENCE MAY PROVE DETRIMENTAL TO SUSTAINING MORE THAN JUST A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT NEAR-TERM ACROSS MIDDLE TN. STILL...SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL VEERING WITH HEIGHT EXISTS IN THE OHX VWP FOR A RISK OF A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO. ..GRAMS.. 06/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STORMS MAY BECOME MARGINALLY SVR INTO THE EARLY EVENING...BUT THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STEEP LAPSE RATES AROUND THE MID-LEVEL COLD POOL ACCOMPANYING A 500-MB CYCLONE OVER E-CNTRL CA/W-CNTRL NV -- I.E. 500-MB TEMPERATURES OF -13C TO -10C -- ARE SUPPORTING MARGINAL BUOYANCY AND SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS PARTS OF THE AREA. THIS ACTIVITY LIES WITHIN A PLUME OF ENHANCED MID-LEVEL MOISTURE THAT ARCS AROUND THE NRN SEMICIRCLE OF THE CYCLONE...AND OROGRAPHIC EFFECTS ARE AUGMENTING LOW-LEVEL ASCENT NEAR A SFC CYCLONE OVER NWRN NV. WEAK MID-LEVEL FLOW PER VWP DATA SUGGEST THAT CONVECTION SHOULD LARGELY REMAIN DISORGANIZED/PULSE IN NATURE. HOWEVER...ISOLATED INSTANCES OF MARGINALLY SVR HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE INTO THE EVENING HOURS AS NEW CONVECTION POTENTIALLY DEVELOPS WWD/NWD AWAY FROM THE MID-LEVEL DRY SLOT SURGING NWD INTO CNTRL NV AND TOWARD AREAS INVOF THE MOIST PLUME WHERE INSOLATION HAS BEEN MORE ABUNDANT. AN ISOLATED SVR WIND GUST OR TWO MAY OCCUR ACROSS PARTS OF NRN NV AND ADJACENT ORE/ID WHERE LARGE SFC TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS IN EXCESS OF 35F EXIST IN SOME INSTANCES. CONVECTION SHOULD WEAKEN AFTER SUNSET AS NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION TAKES PLACE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE INCREASINGLY MARGINAL/LOCALIZED AND GENERALLY CONFINED TO SLOW-MOVING CONVECTION FROM CNTRL KY INTO ERN TN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM WHICH WAS A SUPERCELL EARLIER IN GREEN/ADAIR COUNTIES KY HAS WEAKENED SUBSTANTIALLY IN THE PAST HALF HOUR...WHILE MID-LEVEL REFLECTIVITY CORES HAVE ALSO SUBSIDED WITH CONVECTION MOVING EWD FROM WW 294 INTO 295. THIS APPEARS TO BE IN RESPONSE TO STRONGER FORCED ASCENT SHIFTING E WITH ENTRAINMENT OF INCREASED SUBSIDENCE/DRYING BEHIND THE SHORT WAVE TROUGH AXIS. ALTHOUGH WEAK LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS EVIDENT IN LVX/MRX VWP DATA...SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER FLOW STILL EXISTS FOR AN ORGANIZED STORM OR TWO CAPABLE OF ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL. ..GRAMS.. 06/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TORNADO/DAMAGING WIND THREATS SHOULD EXIST NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS FROM NERN NC...ERN VA INTO CNTRL/ERN MD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A GRADUALLY EWD-EVOLVING QLCS EXTENDED FROM FREDERICK COUNTY MD SWD TO BUCKINGHAM COUNTY VA AS OF 2245Z...WITH ADDITIONAL TSTM CLUSTERS EXTENDING S/SEWD INTO NERN NC. AIR MASS DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY REMAINS VERY MOIST WITH LOWER TO MIDDLE 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS. MORE IMPORTANTLY...0-1 KM SHEAR OF 25-30 KT IS SAMPLED BY AKQ/RAH/LWX VWP DATA AND LOW-LEVEL MESOCYCLONES HAVE BEEN EVIDENT AHEAD OF THE LINE FROM NERN NC INTO SERN VA. A COUPLE OF RECENT TORNADO REPORTS HAVE OCCURRED...AND THIS THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE /ESPECIALLY IN THE SERN VA AREA/ WHERE CURVING LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS ARE LARGEST. ..GRAMS.. 06/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR POTENTIAL ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 292 IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY CONFINED TO FAR SRN PARTS OF THE WW AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING ACROSS MUCH OF WW 292 HAS STABILIZED THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES. A DISCONTINUOUS ORGANIZED SQUALL LINE WILL CONTINUE TO APPROACH THE COAST OF NC AND FAR NRN SC DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...AND COULD POSE A RISK FOR A MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUST OR TWO. HOWEVER...WIDESPREAD LEADING ANVIL SHADING WILL MINIMIZE LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES/BUOYANCY SUCH THAT ANY REMAINING SVR POTENTIAL WITH THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE MINIMAL AMIDST ONLY 20-30 KT OF UNIDIRECTIONAL SWLYS WITHIN THE CLOUD LAYER PER VWP DATA. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY WILL NOT BE NECESSARY...AND AREAS W OF THE SQUALL LINE MAY BE CLEARED FROM THE WW. MEANWHILE...FARTHER S...CONVECTION ENHANCED BY SEA BREEZE CONVERGENCE ZONES OVER PARTS OF ERN SC AND SERN GA MAY GRADUALLY DEVELOP NEWD DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...POTENTIALLY REACHING SRN PARTS OF THE WW. HOWEVER...WITH ONLY AROUND 25 KT OF 0-6-KM BULK SHEAR PER CLX VWP DATA AND ONLY MODEST LOW-LEVEL FLOW...AND GIVEN THE ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING/STABILIZATION...THE SMALL WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY FOR ONLY LIMITED STORM ORGANIZATION SUPPORTING ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS PRECLUDES ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE TO THE S OF WW 292. ..COHEN.. 06/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINAL/LOCALIZED SEVERE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO DIMINISH AND AN ADDITIONAL WW WILL NOT BE NECESSARY BEYOND 02Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ALTHOUGH SCATTERED SHOWERS AND ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE REMAINED ACROSS MIDDLE TN WITHIN A MODEST LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME...THE BROADER LARGE-SCALE PATTERN WILL BE UNFAVORABLE FOR SIGNIFICANT INTENSIFICATION OF UPDRAFTS. ABUNDANT DRY AIR NOTED IN WATER VAPOR IMAGERY IN THE WAKE OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY SHORT WAVE TROUGH IS SAMPLED WELL BY 00Z BNA/BMX RAOBS WITH LAYERS OF SUBSIDENCE NOTED BETWEEN 500-600 MB. THIS WILL CONTINUE LIMIT UPDRAFT INTENSITY AND WITH THE ONSET OF NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING...OVERALL SEVERE THREAT APPEARS MINIMAL. ..GRAMS.. 06/11/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LOW-END TORNADO RISK MAY PERSIST FOR A COUPLE HOURS BEYOND 02Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION OF WW 293. SPC WILL COORDINATE WITH AFFECTED WFOS ON A PROBABLE TEMPORAL EXTENSION OR POSSIBLY A REPLACEMENT WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: N/S-ORIENTED CONVECTIVE BAND CONTINUES TO TRACK EWD AT AROUND 20-25 KT. A FEW TRANSIENT EMBEDDED MESOCYCLONES HAVE BEEN NOTED IN AREA RADAR IMAGERY. GIVEN THE PERVASIVE UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS WITH A LARGE CURVING HODOGRAPH NOTED IN 00Z DOX/AKQ VWP DATA...THERE IS CONCERN THAT A LOW-END TORNADO RISK MAY PERSIST INTO LATE EVENING. STILL...WITH INSTABILITY LACKING IN THE 00Z WAL/IAD RAOBS...THE LONGEVITY OF THE TORNADO THREAT IS A BIT UNCERTAIN.
